Speaker:  Colorado Christian University Staff Member

Topic:  Pursuing the Knowledge of God

Thanks be to the Lord our God -- our 2015 fall semester has gotten off to a great start!

As our semester is well on its way, we want to remember the purpose behind this educational endeavor -- pursuing the knowledge of God.  In order to help keep our focus true and dedication right, we will have available to you chapel meetings throughout the semester.

If you feel like it is a horrible drag to go to a chapel meeting, I understand.  I used to have that same opinion.  But I want to let you know that I came to see that these meetings are definitely worth it.

I came from a Christian home, went to church three times a week, and my school course work often required me to go to other conferences or extra meetings. I often wished that I could separate from these "duties" and be free from it all. Now, however, I see that those meetings, those long "boring" talks, and those people who were good examples of righteousness and who encouraged me to live righteously shaped me into a man who knows how to love and care for his wife (though she can tell you that I am not always the best at this), who can teach and train others for HIS Kingdom, and who lives with confidence in his Savior and Lord.

Come to chapel and see what God has for you there.  As you listen to Him, you will find that He is Faithful and will give His children what they need in order to serve Him in His Kingdom.

Please come and join us to hear a CCU staff member speak on "Pursuing the Knowledge of God"!

Looking forward to seeing you there!

In HIM, Matthew Aden, Principal
